s1.desc: a bedroom with a yellow wooden bed, white pillows and a pale blanket

spans.view: with the yellow headboard and two pillows behind him

beats.text: Pax sleeps tucked under the blanket with his head on the pillow, eyes closed and beak slightly open
Pax opens his eyes one at a time, waking up
Pax lies awake under the blanket, blinking slowly
Pax turns his head to look to the side

spans.notes: Only clean stretch of the skit: no vignette yet (corner brightness constant 0-62), camera locked. Pax's body is under the blanket; head and flippers fully visible.
fast pull back from the close view to a wide view of the bed; the dark vignette starts fading in here
wide bed, Pax alone; dark vignette growing over the whole picture (corners 223 -> 183 luma); 17 frames anyway
Pax brushing his teeth at twin sinks with a frown; camera locked but a dark vignette darkens the edges and keeps growing (effect)
Pax slumped alone at a round table; dark vignette, plus push/pull camera moves (keep12 dips at 165-193)
Pax sweeping up a broken vase by a window strung with crime-scene tape; dark vignette over the whole shot, and a framed photo of Pax and Polly on a little stand (lead copy) in view
insert of the framed photo of Pax and Polly held up close (lead copy; also vignette)
back to the taped-off room, Pax holding the photo; strongest vignette of the skit, plus the lead photo
